text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I broke reason itself and conquered the 
Takarazuka Kinen. Together with my 
comrade-in-arms, I rebelled against 
destiny and destroyed it. And watching 
this race was yet another destiny—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Vodka has reached full maturity. 
Determined to shatter preconceptions, just 
like me, she roars, "I'll surpass Senior 
Gim!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Thus, a feat surpassing even the Main 
Character Rotation has been achieved! I 
have shattered the laws of the world and 
birthed a brand-new legend!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall march beyond legend, into 
myth! Let us shake the world and birth 
utter chaos!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I shall stand at the pinnacle of this era 
as the "God of Destruction." The promised 
land of my descent—the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
